integrity: A complete symbolic proof and standalone standard-library verifier accompany this claim; source descriptions distinguish existing fourth-power sums from new translated-window gcd valuations.
scientific_limitations: The valuations at primes 2, 3, and 5 are not classified; only the prime-at-least-seven primary parts are determined. The finite verifier corroborates, not proves, the universal theorem. Independent review is not performed.
title: All prime factors at least seven in fourth-power Fibonacci window gcds
